name: Sunray Sedona 1-2 Person Indoor Infrared Sauna 100K
description: Description The SunRay Sedona 2-Person Indoor Infrared Sauna is crafted from Canadian red cedar wood for durability and natural appeal. It is equipped with 5 carbon nano infrared heaters that provide even heat distribution up to 140°F while maintaining low EMF levels. Compact in size, the Sedona is ideal for at-home relaxation. Features include dual LED control panels, Bluetooth speakers, recessed and exterior lighting, tempered glass, an oxygen ionization system, a sand timer, and a cup holder.
